statement: Bootstrap readiness normalization preserves an own structured startupRuntimeHandoff witness as an isolated copy so restart recovery can require infrastructure join, canonical authority consumption, and transaction recovery, while absent, inherited, accessor-backed, and malformed witnesses remain fail-closed as null.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Change only the generic readiness normalization projection and its focused deterministic guard. Do not relax the runtime handoff predicate, increase restart timeouts, lower load, or introduce a parallel readiness probe.

Only an own data-property non-array object may become startupRuntimeHandoff evidence; the normalized witness must not alias the response object, and absent, inherited, accessor-backed, primitive, array, and null values remain null.
The deterministic guard must fail when the startupRuntimeHandoff projection is removed while the strict restart recovery predicate remains unchanged.
